name: philterd/philter
what_it_is: Philter is a self-hosted, API-based PII/PHI de-identification service that wraps the Phileas redaction engine and exposes REST endpoints for filtering plain text and PDFs using named filtering policies. It supports redact, mask, replace, and shift strategies and ships with a web UI for interactive use.
components: ph-eye (NER model server for person names)
ph-eye-medical-conditions (NER model server for disease/disorder labels)
Phileas (underlying open-source redaction engine, separate repo)
protocols: REST/HTTP for filtering and policy management
configuration: Server port, Redis cache, policy storage (local dir or S3 bucket)
Per-identifier filter strategies (REDACT, MASK, STATIC_REPLACE, SHIFT_DATE)
PDF redaction: color, DPI, scale, compression, replacement font
ph-eye endpoint and timeout per identifier
constraints: Requires Java 17+ to build and run
ph-eye NER service must be reachable before philter starts
Policy files must exist on disk or in S3; missing policy returns 400
Redis cache disabled by default; requires explicit configuration
GPU acceleration requires NVIDIA container runtime
OpenSearch security plugin disabled in provided compose; not production-ready as-is
notable_absences: No built-in rate limiting or API authentication layer
No audit log or redaction provenance store
